content: {"summary":"Customers report severe delays and failures when deleting photos from iCloud, causing frustration and data loss. Many users cannot access or upload photos, even after updates, and some experience storage errors that prevent new uploads. Two‑factor authentication and account recovery processes are cited as major pain points, with users unable to log in or reset passwords within a reasonable timeframe. The camera app’s performance issues, especially in low light, add to the overall dissatisfaction. Overall, the product must address both deletion speed and account security to improve user trust."}
